verdict.rationale: Mesh is API-first and can run without its UI. Scoped API credentials with optional expiry are created once in the web app. After that, screening runs synchronously, asynchronously or through a Batch Processing API, results arrive via WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks, and cases and alerts can be remediated entirely via the API. A published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema and Postman collection support scripted automation. missing for 10: a CLI or CI-specific tooling/guidance (e.g., pipeline examples), programmatic credential provisioning (credentials are created in the web UI), and hands-on corroboration of authenticated unattended runs.
